title: Frightened (Condition)
html:
Not to be confused with Fearful (Condition)

Frightened

  • The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls.

 Frightened

Properties

 Stack ID: FRIGHTENED

 Status groups: SG_Frightened, SG_Condition

 More properties:
  • InitiateCombat
  • OverheadOnTurn
  • TickingWithSource

Notes

  • This condition may lose duration either at the beginning or the end of the turn, depending on the source. For example, Frightened due to Blood-Curdling Emission and  Menacing Attack (Melee) lose duration at the beginning of the turn, but in the case of  Mortal Reminder duration is lost at the end of the turn.
